ModMetaData.name: Haul Smarter
ModMetaData.author: Bolek98
ModMetaData.description:
Colonists haul several things in one trip – a fixed replacement for Pick Up And Haul and Harvest And Haul.
- Colonists collect several things nearby into their pockets and carry them to storage in one trip. They walk to every item – nothing jumps into the pockets. - Storage is chosen for every item when it is unloaded, by the game's own search: shelves, deep storage and storage mods that hold many things in one cell work. - Respects carrying capacity (also from mods) and forbidden things. - Harvest, wood and mined resources go straight into the pockets; the colonist keeps working and unloads when the pockets are full. - Nothing is ever destroyed: what fits nowhere is put down next to the colonist at home; away from home it stays in the pockets.
New in 3.0: - Profiles: Like the game, Smart (recommended), Maximum, Custom. - What to haul first: rotting food, things outside in the rain or near fire, valuables. - Smart route: the shortest way from the colonist through all items to storage. - Things on the way (gentle): while walking or after a job, a colonist takes a thing lying right next to him – one stack, then a pause, never while hurrying, never above half of his capacity. - Building from the pockets: material a colonist carries goes straight to the construction site. - Weight: bar above the colonist, "carries 42 / 75 kg" and "stored in ~1.5 h" in the inspect pane, optional slowdown for heavy loads. - Hauling overview button: what waits, how heavy, what rots, how many haulers, time until done, who hauled how much (saved with the game), unhauled things outlined on the map.
Turn off Pick Up And Haul and Harvest And Haul – while they are active, the same part of Haul Smarter switches itself off. Czech and English. Safe to add to an existing save.
